# Adjust for donor effect in co-accessibility analysis using logisitc regression

whether, within a donor, fibers where CRE1 is open are more likely to have CRE2 open?

Samples are first summed within the existing `donor` 

For each donor, two grouped-binomial rows represent all shared reads:

| CRE1 status `x` | CRE2 open `y1` | CRE2 closed `y0` |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `CRE2_access` | `co_closed` |
| 1 | `co_access` | `CRE1_access` |


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE,
                     cache = FALSE, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(data.table); library(ggplot2)})
source(file.path(params$code_root, "parsing_functions", "stats_testing_functions.r"), local = TRUE)
data.table::setDTthreads(1L)
```

## Load inputs

#### Aggregate by donor

sums the four cell counts within each (CRE_pair, chrom, donor) group

- donor_all uses every sample on every chr
- donor_male_x keeps only chrX rows from samples with male

```{r aggregate-by-donor}
# tats_testing_functions.r.
donor_all <- aggregate_donors(counts)
male_samples <- sex[sex == "male (XY)", sample_name]
stopifnot(length(male_samples) > 0L)
donor_male_x <- aggregate_donors(counts[chrom == "chrX" & sample_name %in% male_samples])
rm(counts)

print(head(donor_all))
print(head(donor_male_x))
```

## Fit the regression model

For every CRE pair, the model asks whether CRE2 being open on a fiber depends on CRE1 being open, after accounting for which donor the fiber came from.

Each read (fiber) covering both CREs has two binary outcomes: whether CRE1 is open (x) and whether CRE2 is open (y). The model is a logistic regression with CRE2 as the response:
 **logit P(CRE2 open) = donor + beta x (x)**

  - donor is a separate intercept for each donor - donor’s baseline log-odds that CRE2 is open when CRE1 is closed
  - beta is a coefficient shared across all donors. It is the change in log-odds of CRE2 being open when CRE1 is open, within a donor
  - the reported odds ratio is OR_adj = exp(beta)

x is the CRE1 accessibility status of a fiber: a binary indicator

  - x = 1 means CRE1 is open on that fiber
  - x = 0 means CRE1 is closed on that fiber


```{r parallel-and-summary-functions}
# turns any R object into a unique code that changes whenever the object’s contents change
# check if saved results still match the current settings
hash_object <- function(x) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
  on.exit(unlink(tmp))
  saveRDS(x, tmp, version = 3)
  unname(tools::md5sum(tmp))
}

# saves only completed files
atomic_rds <- function(x, path) {
  partial <- paste0(path, ".partial")
  if (file.exists(path) || file.exists(partial))
    stop("Refusing to overwrite summary or incomplete file: ", path)
  saveRDS(x, partial)
  if (!file.rename(partial, path)) stop("Atomic summary rename failed: ", path)
}


fit_chromosome <- function(d, chromosome, male_only = FALSE) {
  expected_ids <- sort(unique(d$CRE_pair), method = "radix")
  fit_summary_file <- file.path(fit_summary_dir, paste0(chromosome,
    if (male_only) "_male_only" else "_all_donors", ".rds"))
  if (file.exists(fit_summary_file)) {
    saved <- readRDS(fit_summary_file)
    stopifnot(identical(saved$signature, summary_signature),
              !anyDuplicated(saved$fits$CRE_pair),
              identical(sort(saved$fits$CRE_pair, method = "radix"), expected_ids))
    message("Reusing summary: ", basename(fit_summary_file))
    return(saved$fits)
  }
  setorder(d, CRE_pair, donor)
  groups <- d[, .(first = .I[1], last = .I[.N]), by = CRE_pair]
  message("Fitting ", nrow(groups), " pairs on ", chromosome,
          if (male_only) " (male only)" else " (all donors)", " using ", cores, " cores")
  fits <- parallel::mclapply(seq_len(nrow(groups)), function(i) {
    fit_pair(d[seq.int(groups$first[i], groups$last[i])], params$min_reads_per_donor)
  }, mc.cores = cores, mc.preschedule = TRUE, mc.set.seed = FALSE)
  # An unexpected worker/code error stops the run; model errors are captured in fit_pair.
  if (any(vapply(fits, inherits, logical(1), what = "try-error")) ||
      any(vapply(fits, is.null, logical(1))))
    stop("A fitting worker failed on ", chromosome, "; no pairs were discarded")
  fits <- rbindlist(fits)
  stopifnot(nrow(fits) == length(expected_ids), !anyDuplicated(fits$CRE_pair),
            setequal(fits$CRE_pair, expected_ids))
  atomic_rds(list(signature = summary_signature, fits = fits), fit_summary_file)
  fits
}


run_analysis <- function(analysis_name) {
  chromosomes <- unique(annotations$chrom)
  fits <- rbindlist(lapply(chromosomes, function(chr) {
    male_only <- analysis_name == "noXCI" && chr == "chrX"
    d <- if (male_only) copy(donor_male_x) else copy(donor_all[chrom == chr])
    fit_chromosome(d, chr, male_only)
  }))
  out <- merge(annotations, fits, by = "CRE_pair", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  stopifnot(nrow(out) == nrow(annotations), !anyNA(out$fit_status),
            !anyDuplicated(out$CRE_pair), setequal(out$CRE_pair, annotations$CRE_pair))
  out[, chrX_rule := fifelse(analysis_name == "noXCI" & chrom == "chrX",
                             "male samples only", "all samples")]
  if (analysis_name == "noXCI")
    out[chrom == "chrX" & fit_status == "no_coverage" &
          !is.na(n_shared_reads_pooled) & n_shared_reads_pooled > 0,
        fit_status := "no_coverage_noXCI"]
  excluded_zero <- sum(out$fit_status %in% c("no_coverage", "no_coverage_noXCI"))
  message(analysis_name, ": excluding ", excluded_zero, " zero-coverage pairs after cohort filtering")
  out <- out[!fit_status %in% c("no_coverage", "no_coverage_noXCI")]
  # One BH call after all chromosomes are combined. Failed fits are NA but
  # count conservatively in the family of pairs with >=1 informative donor.
  family_size <- sum(out$n_donors_informative >= 1L)
  valid <- which(is.finite(out$p_adj_one_sided))
  stopifnot(all(out$p_adj_one_sided[valid] >= 0 & out$p_adj_one_sided[valid] <= 1),
            all(out$n_donors_informative[valid] >= 1L))
  out[, fdr_adj := NA_real_]
  if (length(valid)) out[valid, fdr_adj := adjust_bh(p_adj_one_sided, n = family_size)]
  out[, `:=`(analysis = analysis_name, min_reads_per_donor = as.integer(params$min_reads_per_donor),
    model = fifelse(n_donors_informative == 1L, "CRE2 ~ 1 + CRE1", "CRE2 ~ factor(donor) + CRE1"),
    null_model = fifelse(n_donors_informative == 1L, "CRE2 ~ 1", "CRE2 ~ factor(donor)"),
    fdr_scope = fdr_scope, bh_family_size = family_size, run_signature = summary_signature,
    ci_level = 0.95, glm_maxit = 100L,
    read_rule = "contain", fire_overlap_fraction = 0.5,
    input_coverage_mode = "aligned_blocks_v1")]
  # Rank all successfully tested pairs; CRE_pair is a deterministic final tie-break.
  ranks <- out[is.finite(p_adj_one_sided) & !is.na(OR_adj), .(CRE_pair, fdr_adj, OR_adj)]
  setorderv(ranks, c("fdr_adj", "OR_adj", "CRE_pair"), c(1L, -1L, 1L))
  out[, adjusted_rank := match(CRE_pair, ranks$CRE_pair)]
  setorder(out, chrom, CRE_pair)
  out
}


summary_signature <- hash_object(list(inputs = input_md5,
  min_reads_per_donor = params$min_reads_per_donor,
  statistics_md5 = tools::md5sum(file.path(params$code_root, "parsing_functions", "stats_testing_functions.r")),
  functions = lapply(list(aggregate_donors, capture_fit, fit_pair, fit_chromosome, run_analysis), deparse),
  R = R.version.string, logistf = as.character(packageVersion("logistf"))))
fit_summary_dir <- file.path(output_base, "summary", summary_signature)
dir.create(fit_summary_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cat("Summary key:", summary_signature, "\n")
```

# Write outputs

Genome-wide final tables use the requested paths under
`coaccess/donor_adjusted/all_chr/` and `coaccess/donor_adjusted/noXCI/`.
Smoke-test tables go under `coaccess/donor_adjusted/smoke_tests/chr21/` instead.
Every new file is written to `.partial` in the destination directory, then
renamed. An identical existing result is reused; a different existing result
causes an error rather than an overwrite. After changing inputs/methods, retain
the old results and choose a fresh `output_dir` before exporting the new run.

```{r write-outputs}
atomic_tsv <- function(d, path) {
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    old <- fread(path)
    same <- identical(names(old), names(d)) && nrow(old) == nrow(d)
    if (same) for (column in names(d)) {
      a <- old[[column]]; b <- d[[column]]
      if (all(is.na(a)) && all(is.na(b))) next
      equal <- if (is.numeric(a) && is.numeric(b))
        isTRUE(all.equal(a, b, tolerance = 1e-12, check.attributes = FALSE)) else
        identical(as.character(a), as.character(b))
      if (!equal) { same <- FALSE; break }
    }
    if (!same) stop("Existing output differs; choose a fresh output_dir: ", path)
    return(invisible(path))
  }
  partial <- paste0(path, ".partial")
  if (file.exists(partial)) stop("Incomplete output already exists: ", partial)
  fwrite(d, partial, sep = "\t", na = "NA",
         compress = if (grepl("\\.gz$", path)) "gzip" else "none")
  if (!file.rename(partial, path)) stop("Atomic TSV rename failed: ", path)
  invisible(path)
}
stopifnot(identical(unname(tools::md5sum(input_paths)), unname(input_md5)))
result_sets <- list(all_chr = all_chr_results, noXCI = noxci_results)
for (a in names(result_sets)) {
  path <- file.path(output_dir, a, paste0("LCL_coaccess_pairs_donor_adjusted_", a, ".tsv.gz"))
  atomic_tsv(result_sets[[a]], path)
  cat(a, ":", nrow(result_sets[[a]]), "rows ->", path, "\n")
}
```

# Summary

The positive-association filter is `fdr_adj < 0.05 & OR_adj > 1 &
co_access > expected_co_access_adj`. Pooled comparisons use the original pooled
OR/FDR and all original pooled fibers, including female chrX; they are not a
recomputed noXCI Fisher analysis. Adjusted counts use informative donors only.
Separated pairs have finite Firth effects and score-test p-values; their counts
and presence among the new top ten are shown explicitly. LRT statistics remain
NA for score-tested rows; `score_stat`, `p_Rao`, and `test` identify that branch.

```{r summary-tables}
status_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(names(result_sets), function(a) {
  result_sets[[a]][, .(analysis = a, n_pairs = .N), by = fit_status]
}))
test_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(names(result_sets), function(a) {
  d <- result_sets[[a]]
  data.table(analysis = a, fdr_scope = fdr_scope, n_pairs = nrow(d),
    n_tested = sum(is.finite(d$p_adj_one_sided)),
    n_fit_failed = sum(d$fit_status == "fit_failed"),
    bh_family_size = unique(d$bh_family_size),
    n_separation_positive = sum(d$separation == "positive"),
    n_separation_negative = sum(d$separation == "negative"),
    n_wald_ci_fallback = sum(d$ci_method == "wald_fallback", na.rm = TRUE))
}))
significance_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(names(result_sets), function(a) {
  d <- copy(result_sets[[a]])
  d[, adjusted_positive := !is.na(fdr_adj) & fdr_adj < 0.05 & !is.na(OR_adj) &
      OR_adj > 1 & !is.na(expected_co_access_adj) & co_access > expected_co_access_adj]
  d[, pooled_positive := !is.na(fdr_pooled) & fdr_pooled < 0.05 & OR_pooled > 1 &
      co_access_pooled > expected_co_access_pooled]
  rbindlist(lapply(c("all", "chrX"), function(region) {
    z <- if (region == "chrX") d[chrom == "chrX"] else d
    data.table(analysis = a, region = region, n_pairs = nrow(z),
      adjusted_positive = sum(z$adjusted_positive), pooled_positive = sum(z$pooled_positive),
      separated_significant = sum(z$adjusted_positive & z$separation != "none"),
      separated_positive_significant = sum(z$adjusted_positive & z$separation == "positive"),
      separated_negative_significant = sum(z$adjusted_positive & z$separation == "negative"),
      overlap_positive = sum(z$adjusted_positive & z$pooled_positive))
  }))
}))
top10 <- rbindlist(lapply(result_sets, function(d) d[!is.na(adjusted_rank) & adjusted_rank <= 10L]))

}), fill = TRUE)
```

```{r summary-figures}
atomic_pdf <- function(p, path) {
  if (file.exists(path)) return(invisible(path))
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  partial <- paste0(path, ".partial")
  if (file.exists(partial)) stop("Incomplete plot already exists: ", partial)
  ggsave(partial, p, device = "pdf", width = 9, height = 6)
  if (!file.rename(partial, path)) stop("Atomic PDF rename failed: ", path)
}
for (a in names(result_sets)) {
  d <- result_sets[[a]]
  plot_data <- d[is.finite(OR_pooled) & OR_pooled > 0 & is.finite(OR_adj) & OR_adj > 0]
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(OR_pooled, OR_adj, colour = or_method)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.45, alpha = 0.25) + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(mle = "#2166AC", firth = "#B2182B")) +
    labs(x = "Original pooled odds ratio", y = "Donor-adjusted odds ratio", colour = "OR method",
         title = paste(a, "- pooled versus donor-adjusted effects"),
         subtitle = paste(fdr_scope, "|", nrow(plot_data), "pairs with finite positive ORs")) + theme_bw()
  print(p)
  atomic_pdf(p, file.path(output_dir, a, "plots", "pooled_vs_adjusted_OR.pdf"))
  pvalues <- sort(d$p_adj_one_sided[is.finite(d$p_adj_one_sided)])
  if (length(pvalues)) {
    qq <- data.table(expected = -log10(ppoints(length(pvalues))),
                     observed = -log10(pmax(pvalues, .Machine$double.xmin)))
    q <- ggplot(qq, aes(expected, observed)) + geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.3) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "#B2182B") +
      labs(x = "Expected -log10(p) under uniform null", y = "Observed -log10(p)",
           title = paste(a, "- one-sided p-value QQ plot"),
           subtitle = paste(fdr_scope, "| LRT for non-separated; Rao score for separated pairs")) + theme_bw()
    print(q)
    atomic_pdf(q, file.path(output_dir, a, "plots", "pvalue_QQ.pdf"))
  }
}
```
